articles.title: Voter Guide Meet the Judicial Candidates on the Nov Ballot
articles.excerpt: Audra Riley is a criminal district court judge in Dallas and a graduate of Thurgood Marshall School of Law (San Antonio Report).

articles.title: Texas Supreme Court Criminal Appeals Results Elections
articles.excerpt: Nov. 3, 2026 result: Audra Riley won the race for Court of Criminal Appeals, Place 4 with 4,996,898 votes (51.7%); opponent: Kevin Patrick Yeary (R) 4,659,299 (48.3%), in unofficial returns (Texas Secretary of State; The Texas Tribune).
